notes: This catalog does NOT duplicate the logic in eval/controller_walk.py or frontend/test_app.py -- it is a human-readable index of which controller/integration behaviours are already covered by an executable, deterministic test, and which are known gaps. Run the referenced test files to get a pass/fail result; this JSON is for traceability (Phase 4.5/5.1), not a separate test runner.

scenarios.description: Correct answer on first attempt -> SOLVED, terminal, celebratory action with practice/new-question buttons.
scenarios.evidence_type: pure controller unit test, no LLM

scenarios.description: Two wrong attempts at intermediate level -> CO_SOLVE, terminal, outcome=shown.
scenarios.evidence_type: pure controller unit test, no LLM

scenarios.description: Advanced-level student held for 3 wrong attempts (vs 2 for beginner/intermediate) before CO_SOLVE.
scenarios.evidence_type: pure controller unit test, no LLM

scenarios.description: Hint request does not count as a wrong attempt; a correct attempt after a hint still reaches SOLVED.
scenarios.evidence_type: pure controller unit test, no LLM

scenarios.description: Cold SOLVE request (zero prior attempts) -> one REDIRECT, not terminal; a second SOLVE request is honoured as REVEAL.
scenarios.evidence_type: pure controller unit test, no LLM

scenarios.description: SOLVE request honoured immediately (no redirect) once at least one attempt has already been made.
scenarios.evidence_type: pure controller unit test, no LLM

scenarios.description: GIVE_UP -> CO_SOLVE, terminal, outcome=gave_up (distinct outcome from the wrong-attempt-threshold CO_SOLVE).
scenarios.evidence_type: pure controller unit test, no LLM

scenarios.description: NEW_QUESTION intent signals a fresh episode (phase=NEW, outcome=moved_on) regardless of current phase.
scenarios.evidence_type: pure controller unit test, no LLM

scenarios.description: An attempt with several numbers in the working (ambiguous which is the final answer) -> ASK_ANSWER, not graded wrong.
scenarios.evidence_type: pure controller unit test, no LLM

scenarios.description: Student answer extraction reads the value after '=', after the word 'answer', or the sole number in free text.
scenarios.evidence_type: pure controller unit test, no LLM

scenarios.description: A conceptual attempt (is_math=False) -> ACK_CONCEPTUAL, not terminal, not graded.
scenarios.evidence_type: pure controller unit test, no LLM

scenarios.description: A conceptual (is_math=False, computed_answer=None) episode returns ACK_CONCEPTUAL for EVERY subsequent attempt regardless of content, and never increments the attempt counter or reaches a terminal phase. This is the deterministic root cause behind the repetitive/non-recognising behaviour observed in the reviewed 'fractions' conversation (see docs/evaluation_paper_alignment.md and eval/datasets/conceptual/v1_starter.jsonl).
scenarios.status: deterministic, passing (confirms the LIMITATION exists, not that it is resolved)
scenarios.evidence_type: pure controller unit test against the real state machine, no LLM, no mocking

scenarios.description: Generation failure (exception) after controller.step() has already mutated the TutorState does not commit the advanced state; the episode is left exactly as it was before the failed turn.
scenarios.evidence_type: mocked integration test (pipeline.generate_turn mocked to raise); no real LLM call

scenarios.description: Retrying the identical input after a generation failure advances the controller exactly once (no duplicate attempt/hint/feedback from the failed call).
scenarios.evidence_type: mocked integration test; no real LLM call

scenarios.description: An empty generation result (no exception, but no text from any provider) is treated the same as a raised exception -- rolled back, not committed as a successful turn.
scenarios.evidence_type: mocked integration test; no real LLM call

scenarios.description: A failed FIRST turn of a brand-new episode leaves chat['episode'] as None rather than silently starting an episode the student never saw.
scenarios.evidence_type: mocked integration test; no real LLM call

scenarios.description: Attempt recording: DIAGNOSE_CORRECT -> correct=True; DIAGNOSE_WRONG (terminal or not) and threshold-triggered CO_SOLVE -> correct=False; GIVE_UP and a cold REVEAL (zero prior attempts) -> not recorded at all; HINT/ACK_CONCEPTUAL -> not recorded.
scenarios.evidence_type: mocked unit test on _record_outcome; no real LLM call

scenarios.description: Post-generation verification: a matching stated answer verifies True, a disagreeing one verifies False, an unreadable final number verifies as 'unverifiable' (not silently correct), and non-reveal/non-co_solve turns are not checked at all.
scenarios.evidence_type: deterministic unit test (sympy-only, no LLM call needed since computed_value is pre-supplied)

scenarios.description: Correct answer on first attempt, live end-to-end (real LLM generation + real verification).
scenarios.test_reference: manual live smoke test, see docs/development_test_log.md
scenarios.status: real-LLM smoke test, passing (single run, not a statistical sample)
scenarios.evidence_type: real provider call

scenarios.description: Wrong attempt -> hint -> correct attempt, live end-to-end.
scenarios.test_reference: manual live smoke test, see docs/development_test_log.md
scenarios.evidence_type: real provider call

scenarios.description: Cold-solve request -> redirect -> second request honoured as reveal, with real post-check agreement, live end-to-end.
scenarios.test_reference: manual live smoke test, see docs/development_test_log.md
scenarios.evidence_type: real provider call

scenarios.description: Give-up -> co-solve, live end-to-end, with real post-check agreement.
scenarios.test_reference: manual live smoke test, see docs/development_test_log.md

scenarios.description: New question introduced mid-episode correctly closes the old episode and starts a new one with the new question as state.question, live end-to-end.
scenarios.test_reference: manual live smoke test, see docs/development_test_log.md
scenarios.evidence_type: real provider call

scenarios.description: 'Practice problem' shortcut: proposed future scenario, NOT currently implementable -- no problem-generation capability exists. Expected behaviour if implemented: controller offers a new, similar-difficulty, curriculum-grounded problem after a correct answer.
scenarios.evidence_type: not applicable

scenarios.description: Intent-classification accuracy for free-text input (as opposed to button-bypassed intents) against a labelled set of child-like phrasings. NOT yet covered by any test in this repository -- scripts/llm/intent.py has no dedicated accuracy evaluation.
scenarios.test_reference: none (proposed future work, see eval/datasets/conceptual and the multi_turn set for seed phrasings)
scenarios.evidence_type: not applicable
